verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a PR-review bot triggered via comments/webhooks within Cursor's IDE and git integrations, not a product exposing its own public API surface; the evidence pack shows only human-readable/markdown docs (llms.txt, docs/bugbot.md) rather than any machine-readable API spec like OpenAPI, and there's no indication Bugbot has a callable API at all — this axis doesn't fit the product's category.
